categories.main_business_segments: Trip.com Group Limited operates as a leading global one-stop travel service provider offering a comprehensive suite of travel products and services. Its primary segments include accommodation reservation, transportation ticketing, packaged tours, corporate travel management, and other travel-related services such as online advertising and financial services. The company operates multiple brands including Ctrip, Qunar, Trip.com, and Skyscanner.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI capabilities, proprietary search and transaction engines, natural language processing, speech recognition, computer vision, and conversational AI to enhance user experience and operational efficiency. It employs proprietary booking software systems, cloud technologies, and data analytics to support personalized recommendations, streamlined booking, and real-time inventory management. Technology solutions also support ecosystem partners with e-booking systems and pricing error monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Trip.com Group serves leisure and business travelers globally, with a strong focus on the Asia-Pacific region. Its customers include individual travelers booking accommodations, transportation tickets, packaged tours, and corporate clients requiring managed travel services. The company also serves ecosystem partners such as hotels, airlines, car rental companies, and advertisers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with significant operations in China and expanding influence in Asia-Pacific and other international markets. Its transportation ticketing network covers over 220 countries and regions, and its platforms support multiple languages and currencies. It maintains customer service centers and offline stores in various countries including China, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Trip.com Group operates primarily as an online travel agency acting as an agent in travel transactions, connecting users with ecosystem partners who provide travel products and services. It functions midstream in the travel supply chain by aggregating offerings from hotels, airlines, and other service providers, facilitating bookings, and providing value-added services without owning the underlying travel inventory.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes investment in AI, cloud technologies, and proprietary platform development to enhance personalized user experiences and operational efficiency. It focuses on expanding its one-stop travel platform, upgrading content capabilities including live streaming, and strengthening ecosystem partnerships. Research and development efforts also include improving booking software, customer relationship management, and yield management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Trip.com Group generates revenue primarily through commissions from accommodation reservations and transportation ticketing services. It also earns referral fees from packaged tours, service fees from corporate travel management, and revenues from online advertising and financial services. Revenue recognition is generally at the point when performance obligations are satisfied, such as ticket issuance or non-cancelable reservations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other online travel agencies, local and international consolidators, traditional travel agencies, and increasingly with hotels and airlines selling directly. It holds a leading position in the Asian travel market and is expanding globally. Competitors include both established travel platforms and emerging content and social network platforms entering the travel industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Trip.com Group has demonstrated significant growth with total revenues increasing from RMB20.0 billion in 2022 to RMB53.4 billion (US$7.3 billion) in 2024. Net income rose from RMB1.4 billion in 2022 to RMB17.2 billion (US$2.4 billion) in 2024. The company operates with over 41,000 employees globally and maintains substantial assets and liquidity, supported by cash flows from operations and financing activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a user-centric, one-stop travel platform offering personalized, convenient, and inspirational travel experiences. It differentiates through advanced AI-driven recommendations, comprehensive travel content including user-generated reviews and live streaming, and an extensive ecosystem of partners providing diverse travel products. Its omni-channel approach integrates online and offline touchpoints, supported by high-quality user support and technology-enabled solutions for partners.
